name: Sanctuary of Asklepios at Epidaurus
description: In a quiet Peloponnesian valley, Epidaurus was the ancient Greek world's great healing retreat, dedicated to Asklepios, god of medicine. Pilgrims came for cures at its temples and hospital-like buildings, and the shrine rivalled Olympia and Delphi in fame. Today you can wander the ruins, including the round Tholos, and sit in the famous 4th-century BC theatre.
